added: Swap a dance in Perform: Adjust program offers Swap this dance for the dance you are calling, and a swap button on each upcoming dance. It is not offered on a dance marked performed, on an alternate whose planned dance is marked performed, on a note, a break or an earlier slot, and swapping an upcoming dance keeps your place.

The swap sheet opens already searched, with Keep choices taken from the dance: same formation, this level or easier, same type (contra, English or square) in a program that mixes types, not already in tonight's program, and the dance's figures, each with In the same phrase and With what comes before it. A filter hidden in Settings and a free-text figure are not offered. Results change as you go, the slot's alternates are listed first, the dance being swapped is never listed, and More filters shows the same choices in the full search panels.

A swap keeps the slot's note, guest caller and times and can be undone. The dance swapped in takes the planned slot, so calling history counts it, and the dance swapped out stays as an unmarked alternate, which it does not count: right after the slot, or, when you choose one of the slot's alternates, in that alternate's place. Swapping an alternate shown with Show alternate makes it the planned dance and the old planned dance an alternate, except in a group that starts with a note or a break, where the alternate is swapped in place and stays an alternate.

If another device changed the program meanwhile so that any change made in Perform's Adjust sheet (a swap, a note, a performed mark) or an Undo would land on the wrong dance, that change is not saved: Perform shows the program as stored, keeping any later change, and says so (on the screen you returned to if Perform has closed), and asks you to make it again if you still want it. An edit in an Adjust sheet that was open meanwhile is put on the program as shown, unless it too would land on the wrong dance, in which case it is not saved and the same message shows.
For English dances, same formation and the two figure refinements are not offered yet, and the swap sheet says so.

Settings ▸ Program ▸ Perform mode ▸ Swap a dance chooses which Keep choices start on. It is in your backup, and syncs to your other devices once every device in the store has a version of the app that knows it. If a newer version of the app saved the choices, this version uses its starting choices (all on) and won't overwrite the newer ones; if they can't be read, the screen says so and changes nothing.

Add SwapKeepSeed (with hiddenFacets), SwapKeepFigure, SwapKeepChoices, SwapFigureKeep and swapKeepPanelState: the Keep choices a dance seeds for Perform's swap sheet, and the CollectionPanelState they search for.

Add PerformSwapDefaults, PerformSwapDefaultsRead, PerformSwapKeepItem, performSwapDefaultsVersion, readPerformSwapDefaults and isValidStoredPerformSwapDefaults for the stored perform_swap_defaults value.

Add Program.swapSlotDanceKeepingAlternate, which swaps a slot's dance, keeps the old dance on an unmarked alternate in the same group (a new one after the slot, or an unperformed alternate that already holds the new dance, by trading), and makes an alternate slot its group's primary so the new dance is the one that counts, unless the group starts with a note or a break, where the alternate is swapped in place.
Add the performSwap.v1 sync capability (SyncCapabilities.performSwapV1), gating perform_swap_defaults, and classify the key in the settings privacy registry.
